# Executive Summary

The **2026 Mozambique Multi-Sector Needs Assessment (MSNA)** provides evidence-based humanitarian data on household living conditions, cross-sectoral vulnerabilities, and educational access across all 11 provinces of Mozambique.

This analytical report synthesizes findings generated through standardized **IMPACT Initiatives** methodologies:
1. **[Humind MSNI Workflow](https://impact-initiatives-hppu.github.io/humind/articles/msni-workflow.html)**: Multi-Sector Needs Index (MSNI) and Sectoral Living Standards Gaps (LSGs).
2. **[EduAnalysisTool](https://github.com/martivit/EduAnalysisTool)**: Comprehensive individual and household-level education sector metrics.

# Multi-Sector Needs Index (MSNI)

The **Multi-Sector Needs Index (MSNI)** reflects the overall severity of acute humanitarian need at the household level. It is calculated as the maximum severity score observed across six sectoral Living Standards Gaps (LSGs):
$$\text{MSNI} = \max(\text{LSG}_{\text{FoodSec}}, \text{LSG}_{\text{WASH}}, \text{LSG}_{\text{Edu}}, \text{LSG}_{\text{Health}}, \text{LSG}_{\text{SNFI}}, \text{LSG}_{\text{Prot}})$$

Each sectoral LSG is scored on a standardized 1 to 4+ scale:
* **Phase 1 (None)**: Living standards met without external assistance.
* **Phase 2 (Stress)**: Moderate stress with basic coping mechanisms.
* **Phase 3 (Crisis / In Need)**: Substantial acute Living Standards Gap.
* **Phase 4+ (Severe / Extreme Need)**: Severe life-threatening or irreversible gaps.

## MSNI Severity Distribution by Province

The chart below shows the distribution of MSNI severity scores across all 11 provinces (`MZ01` to `MZ11`):

```{r fig_msni_phases}
dist_df <- res_tbl$msni_distribution
dist_df$Score_Label <- factor(
  paste("Phase", dist_df$msni_score),
  levels = c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3", "Phase 4")
)

ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = admin1, y = Percentage, fill = Score_Label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.72) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "MSNI Severity",
    values = c("Phase 1" = "#2ecc71", "Phase 2" = "#f1c40f", "Phase 3" = "#e67e22", "Phase 4" = "#e74c3c")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "MSNI Severity Phase Distribution by Province",
    subtitle = "Percentage of households in each MSNI Phase (1 to 4+)",
    x = "Province (P-Code)",
    y = "Percentage of Households (%)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#002060")
  )
```

## Sectoral Living Standards Gaps Comparison

Comparison of the percentage of households found **in need** ($\ge 3$) and **in severe need** ($\ge 4$) across the six assessed sectors:

```{r fig_sectoral_lsg}
sectors_comp <- data.frame(
  Sector = c("Food Security", "Shelter & NFI", "WASH", "Education", "Protection", "Health"),
  In_Need = c(
    nat_msni$comp_foodsec_in_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_snfi_in_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_wash_in_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_edu_in_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_prot_in_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_health_in_need__mean
  ),
  Severe_Need = c(
    nat_msni$comp_foodsec_in_severe_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_snfi_in_severe_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_wash_in_severe_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_edu_in_severe_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_prot_in_severe_need__mean,
    nat_msni$comp_health_in_severe_need__mean
  )
)

sectors_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  sectors_comp,
  cols = c("In_Need", "Severe_Need"),
  names_to = "Severity_Type",
  values_to = "Percentage"
)
sectors_long$Severity_Type <- factor(
  sectors_long$Severity_Type,
  levels = c("In_Need", "Severe_Need"),
  labels = c("In Need (Score >= 3)", "Severe Need (Score >= 4)")
)

ggplot(sectors_long, aes(x = reorder(Sector, Percentage), y = Percentage, fill = Severity_Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "",
    values = c("In Need (Score >= 3)" = "#e67e22", "Severe Need (Score >= 4)" = "#c0392b")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Sectoral Needs Comparison (National Level)",
    subtitle = "Percentage of households with Living Standards Gap (LSG) >= 3 and >= 4",
    x = "",
    y = "Percentage of Households (%)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#002060")
  )
```

# Education In-Depth Analysis (EduAnalysisTool)

The analysis is conducted at the individual child level across school-age children (**5 to 17 years old**, $N = `r format(nat_edu$Sample_Size, big.mark=",")`$).

## Out-of-School (OOS) Rates by Age Category and Gender

Children were classified into four school-age categories aligned with the **Mozambique National Education System (SNE)**:
* **5 years old (ECE)**: Early Childhood Education / Entry age for Primary grade 1.
* **6 to 11 years old**: Primary School Age (Grades 1 to 6).
* **12 to 15 years old**: Lower Secondary School Age (Grades 7 to 10).
* **16 to 17 years old**: Upper Secondary School Age (Grades 11 to 12).

```{r fig_edu_age_gender}
age_df <- res_tbl$education$Edu_AgeCat_National %>%
  dplyr::filter(school_age_cat != "not_school_age") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    school_age_cat,
    `Out of School (%)` = is_out_of_school__mean,
    `Over-Age Attendance (%)` = is_overage_2plus__mean,
    `Recent Disruption (%)` = any_disruption__mean
  )

age_df$Age_Label <- dplyr::case_when(
  age_df$school_age_cat == "5_years_ece" ~ "5 years (ECE)",
  age_df$school_age_cat == "primary_school_age" ~ "6-11 years (Primary)",
  age_df$school_age_cat == "lower_secondary_age" ~ "12-15 years (Lower Sec)",
  age_df$school_age_cat == "upper_secondary_age" ~ "16-17 years (Upper Sec)",
  TRUE ~ age_df$school_age_cat
)

age_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  age_df,
  cols = c("Out of School (%)", "Over-Age Attendance (%)", "Recent Disruption (%)"),
  names_to = "Metric",
  values_to = "Percentage"
)

ggplot(age_long, aes(x = Age_Label, y = Percentage, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "",
    values = c("Out of School (%)" = "#e74c3c", "Over-Age Attendance (%)" = "#3498db", "Recent Disruption (%)" = "#f39c12")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Key Education Indicators by School-Age Category",
    subtitle = "Out-of-school, over-age attendance, and disruption rates across age brackets",
    x = "School-Age Category",
    y = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#002060")
  )
```

## Over-Age Attendance & Grade Delay

Over-age attendance occurs when an enrolled student is **at least two years older than the official intended age** for their grade.
Nationally, **`r paste0(nat_edu$is_overage_2plus__mean, "%")`** of attending students are over-age, indicating cumulative learning disruption, delayed entry, or grade repetition.

## Education Disruption Events

Among students currently attending school, **`r paste0(nat_edu$any_disruption__mean, "%")`** experienced at least one major disruption during the school year. The breakdown by disruption event is:

* **Natural Hazards (floods, cyclones, droughts)**: `r paste0(nat_edu$disrupt_hazard__mean, "%")`
* **Teacher Absences / Strikes**: `r paste0(nat_edu$disrupt_teacher__mean, "%")`
* **School Used as Shelter for Displaced Populations**: `r paste0(nat_edu$disrupt_shelter__mean, "%")`
* **Direct Attack or Security Incidents**: `r paste0(nat_edu$disrupt_attack__mean, "%")`

## Main Barriers Preventing Children from Attending School

For children who are **out of school** (`r paste0(nat_edu$is_out_of_school__mean, "%")` of all school-age children), the reported barriers are:

```{r fig_barriers}
barriers_df <- data.frame(
  Barrier = c(
    "Financial Costs (fees, uniforms, materials)",
    "Distance / Far Away",
    "Safety / Insecurity on Journey",
    "Early Marriage / Pregnancy",
    "Lack of Documentation / Birth Certificate",
    "Disability or Health Condition",
    "School is Closed"
  ),
  Percentage = c(
    nat_edu$barrier_cost__mean,
    nat_edu$barrier_distance__mean,
    nat_edu$barrier_safety__mean,
    nat_edu$barrier_marriage_pregnancy__mean,
    nat_edu$barrier_documentation__mean,
    nat_edu$barrier_disability__mean,
    nat_edu$barrier_closed__mean
  )
)

ggplot(barriers_df, aes(x = reorder(Barrier, Percentage), y = Percentage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#34495e", width = 0.65) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.8, fontface = "bold") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Reported Barriers to School Attendance",
    subtitle = "Percentage of out-of-school children affected by each barrier",
    x = "",
    y = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(barriers_df$Percentage) * 1.15) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#002060")
  )
```

# Technical & Methodological Notes

1. **Analytical Framework**:
   - The analysis adheres to the [IMPACT R Analysis Guidelines](https://github.com/impact-initiatives-hppu/humind) and [MSNI Guidance 2026](https://impact-initiatives-hppu.github.io/humind/articles/msni-workflow.html).
   - Education metrics follow the [EduAnalysisTool](https://github.com/martivit/EduAnalysisTool) methodology.
2. **Denominators**:
   - Education access and disruption rates are computed over eligible school-age children (5-17 years old) with valid responses.
   - Barriers to education are computed over out-of-school children.
   - MSNI metrics are computed over all surveyed households.
3. **Reproducibility**:
   - This report is auto-generated by `analysis/run_analysis.R`.
   - Complete analytical tables and clean datasets are archived in `analysis/output/`.
